metadata.title: tarot-spark
metadata.description: Add optional context, choose a tarot spread and reading style, and create an AI-ready reflection prompt.

heading: Turn your situation and a tarot spread into a stronger AI prompt.
intro: Choose a topic and draw right away, or add a little context to make the prompt more specific.
deckPreviewNote: Current deck: {count}-card illustrated Major Arcana preview.
personalizationIntro: Choose how much detail you want and the tone of the answer. Tarot does not prove the future or another person's thoughts.
contextHelp: Your situation stays out of shared links and analytics. It is included in the prompt you copy and will be sent if you paste it into another AI tool. Keep out names, contact details, and workplace secrets.
customizeCurrentIntro: Adjust the answer style or your private situation for these same cards.
editNextIntro: Your current cards stay here until you draw with these new settings.

sharedReading.heading: A tarot-spark reading was shared with you.
sharedReading.intro: Explore the drawn cards and Prompt Pack first. You can copy a prompt or create a separate reading of your own.

instantReading.heading: Read the card flow
instantReading.intro: Create one connected interpretation from the drawn cards and selected reading options. Optional situation text is not sent or used.
instantReading.eligibility: This test feature is available to people aged 18 and over.
instantReading.loading: Reading the flow of the cards…
instantReading.unavailable: The instant reading is unavailable right now. You can still copy the prompt below and continue in another tool.
instantReading.disclosure: This interpretation was created with generative AI.

promptPack.heading: Change prompt type
promptPack.intro: Choose another way to explore the same cards.

main.label: Main reading
main.description: A detailed connected interpretation with alternatives and next steps.

other-view.label: Other perspective
other-view.description: Challenges the first interpretation and tests overlooked assumptions.

action.label: Action plan
action.description: Turns the spread into options, tradeoffs, and small reversible steps.

emotion.label: Emotion check-in
emotion.description: Separates feelings, evidence, needs, and boundaries without diagnosing.

promptReady: Your prompt for an AI tool is ready.
promptContextIncluded: Your situation is included in the prompt.
promptCopySuccess: Copied. Paste it into the AI tool you use to get the reading.
promptCopyBlockedAction: Copying did not work. Select the opened prompt below and copy it manually.
shareBlockedAction: Sharing did not work. Select the privacy-safe link below and copy it manually.
emptyBody: Choose a topic and draw right away. You can also add context or change the card count and reading style.
disclaimer: Tarot content is for entertainment and self-reflection only. It is not medical, legal, financial, investment, or mental-health advice.
